title: Process: fix own conflicting and needs-rework PRs before any new task

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P4
labels.description: Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut

body:
## What is missing

AGENTS.md has no rule that makes an agent fix its own blocked pull requests before it starts new work. Open PRs with `conflicts` or `needs-rework` wait while agents claim new issues.

## The maintainer's words (2026-11-21)

"Lets add a new law to the AGENTS.md before each new task start. Check Pull requests that is created by current user account - that has label "conflicts, need-rework". And then fix those before picking up any new issue. Make sure this is a docs change that get pushed and merged and signaled over issue 681 as a process change. On the process change dictate that agent files and skills should be reloaded."

## Required change

- Add a new law to AGENTS.md. Name it in bold, as the other rules are named, so that skills and agents can cite it. Suggested name: **Own blocked PRs first**.
- The law: before an agent claims or starts any new issue, it lists the open PRs of the current account that carry `conflicts` or `needs-rework` (`gh pr list --state open --author @me --label conflicts` and `--label needs-rework`; the label is `needs-rework`). The agent fixes each one before it picks a new issue.
  - `conflicts`: merge `origin/main` into the branch (never rebase, never force-push), run the targeted gate, push, as the `resolve-conflicts` skill says.
  - `needs-rework`: fix each review finding on the same branch with a plain push, as "Pull Request Law" says (the PR is a draft first, `needs-rework` is replaced when the review is clean).
  - The existing orders stay first: a `P1` or `P2` PR before other PRs, and the standing order for outside PRs.
- Reconcile the existing text that this law changes. "Refresh only at merge time" says that the author's agents do not touch a conflicting PR. The new law overrides this for the PRs of the current account. Edit that bullet so the two rules do not disagree.
- Add the check as a step to the skills and agents that start work: `work-issue` (step before the claim), `.claude/agents/coordinator.md` (before it dispatches a worker for a new issue), and the `issue-worker-*` agent files if they claim an issue. Keep each edit to a few lines.
- A PR of this change has the line `Process change: yes` in its body. It does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

## Process change notice

The merging session runs `cargo xtask process-bump` after the merge and comments on the pinned issue #681. The comment must say: **agent files and skills must be reloaded** (a running session reloads `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/agents/` and `.claude/skills/`; a fork syncs them as `fork-sync` says). Add this "reload" line to the fixed format of the #681 comment in AGENTS.md, so that each process notice carries it.

## Done means

- The law is in AGENTS.md and the edited bullet does not disagree with it.
- `work-issue`, the coordinator agent and the issue-worker agents carry the check.
- The PR is merged, the process bump PR is merged, and #681 has the comment with the reload instruction.
